card.name: Start of brand and drug names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name that is split into parts, often an all-caps brand name like LENVIMA, RENFLEXIS or BIMZELX, right after words like 'on', 'for', 'initiating' or 'use of'. It also fires partway through generic names such as quinapril, isradipine and candesartan.

modes.label: Capitalized brand names
modes.description: The opening letter or piece of an all-caps brand name after a verb or preposition.

modes.label: Generic names, early part
modes.description: A middle piece of a generic drug name, before the ending is completed, often near hydrochlorothiazide combinations.
modes.example: Regimens of therapy with qu<<in>>april and hydrochlorothiazide

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the rest of the drug name, not toward unrelated word starts.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug name has just begun and the rest of the name is still to come.
